paths.title: Documents & Knowledge Academy
paths.tagline: Ground AI in your own documents with Claude Projects and Gemini — answers you can actually verify
paths.description: A ladder from creating your first Claude Project and loading it with real documents through asking grounded questions and verifying every quote yourself, synthesizing across multiple documents, building a Gemini-powered study system from your course materials, turning sources into work-ready briefings, maintaining a living client or project knowledge base, reconciling documents that disagree, and running advanced Workspace-grounded knowledge workflows for a whole team.
